attribute.name.ftb.lh_blood_needles.desc: 当你攻击敌人时，你的精怪同伴有25%的几率向目标发射血针。法术等级随等级提升。
attribute.name.ftb.lh_death_defiance.des: 受到致命伤害时，你的精怪会抵消你的死亡并在你周围制造一个击退环。60秒冷却时间。
attribute.name.ftb.lh_eclipse_strike.des: 当你攻击敌人时，你的精怪有20%的几率为你施放回响打击，造成额外攻击。法术等级随品阶提升。
attribute.name.ftb.lh_fire_ward.desc: 当你受到火焰伤害时，你的精怪会赋予火焰抗性。等级决定增益效果的持续时间。
attribute.name.ftb.lh_frost_aura.desc: 当敌对生物进入8格范围内时，你的精怪有25%的几率在你周围施放霜冻波。品阶会提升该法术的等级。
attribute.name.ftb.lh_frost_hex.desc: 当你受到伤害时，你的精怪有30%的几率对附近的敌人施加一个随机减益效果。减益持续时间受等级影响。
attribute.name.ftb.lh_heat_surge.desc: 当你的生命值低于12点时，你的精怪有50%的几率施放热能涌动。法术等级随等级提升。
attribute.name.ftb.lh_inferno_armor.desc: 当你受到伤害时，你的精怪有30%的几率赋予你神圣守护和抗火效果。持续时间随等级提升。
attribute.name.ftb.lh_serpents_gift.desc: 当你受到伤害时，你的精怪有25%的几率给予一个随机正面增益效果。增益持续时间随等级提升。
attribute.name.ftb.lh_shadow_step.desc: 当你受到伤害时，你的精怪有25%的几率施放血步，将你移出危险范围。法术等级随精怪等级提升。
attribute.name.ftb.lh_shockwave.desc: 当有生物在你的近战范围内时你受到伤害，你的精怪会施放冲击波将他们击退。等级决定法术等级。
attribute.name.ftb.lh_soul_devour.desc: 当你击杀敌人时，你的精怪会对你施放生命祝福。祝福等级随精怪等级提升。
attribute.name.ftb.lh_soul_heal.desc: 当你的生命值低于15点时，你的精怪有80%的几率对你施放治疗。等级越高，治疗强度越大。
attribute.name.ftb.lh_spectral_phase.des: 当你受到伤害时，你的精怪有25%的几率用树皮保护你。增益强度随等级提升。
attribute.name.ftb.lh_spirit_shield.desc: 当你被箭矢击中时，你的精怪会对你施放护盾。等级会提升增益效果的持续时间。
attribute.name.ftb.lh_tidal_pull.desc: 当你击中敌人时，你的精怪有20%的几率施放黑洞，将敌人拉向你的目标。等级会提升法术等级。
attribute.puffish_attributes.fortune.des: 为你的采矿掉落物增加额外时运等级。由亚尔夫海姆技能树授予。
attribute.puffish_attributes.magic_damag: 额外魔法伤害作用于法术和魔法饰品。由密米尔之井（魔法技能树）提供。
attribute.puffish_attributes.magic_resis: 所受魔法伤害的倍率。由穆斯贝尔海姆和亚尔夫海姆技能树提供。
attribute.puffish_attributes.melee_damag: 近战武器伤害倍率。由赫尔和尼弗尔海姆技能树提供。
attribute.puffish_attributes.melee_resis: 受到的近战伤害倍率。由穆斯贝尔海姆和米德加德技能树提供。
attribute.puffish_attributes.natural_reg: 被动生命恢复倍率。由约顿海姆、尼弗尔海姆和穆斯贝尔海姆技能树提供。在更高等级时变得非常强大。
attribute.puffish_attributes.pickaxe_spe: 镐的挖掘速度倍率。由穆斯贝尔海姆和米德加德技能树赋予。
attribute.puffish_attributes.ranged_dama: 弓和弩伤害的倍率。由赫尔和约顿海姆技能树提供。
attribute.puffish_attributes.ranged_resi: 对受到的远程伤害的倍率。由穆斯贝尔海姆和亚尔夫海姆技能树提供。
通用伤害减免倍率，在类型特定抗性之后应用。由穆斯贝尔海姆技能树提供。
attribute.puffish_attributes.stamina.des: 冲刺和跳跃耐力池。由每个领域的技能树授予。

effect.ftb.deus_ex_machina.activate: 你已进入机械降神状态！在你被Boss击败后，你将获得抗性并对Boss造成更多伤害！
effect.ftb.deus_ex_machina.desc: 一种让你更加强大的状态。死亡后，你将变得更加强大。
ftb.cataclysm_eye.wrong_dim: 这个遗物在此领域中不会脉动。回到它结构被雕刻而成的世界吧。
ftb.spell.recall.disabled: 命运的丝线牢固不移。通往米德加德的道路依然封闭。
ftb.prelude_gateway.wrong_dim: 珍珠在悸动，却无法在此处开启。诸神黄昏的前奏，唯有在阿斯加德才能引动。
ftb.prelude_gateway.too_close: 珍珠在悸动，但阿斯加德的殿堂距此过近，无法承受这等力量。请远离领域中心，向更远处前行。
ftb.prelude_gateway.ragnarok: 诸神黄昏已至！珍珠碎裂，传送门开启！
ftb.codex.glyph.nomore: 你已经解锁了所有符文，因此获得了一些经验值作为替代！
ftb.dimension.blocked: 通往此领域的道路被封闭。
ftb.dimension.ejected: 你已被送回大厅。你缺乏进入此领域的权限。
ftb.dimension.end_portal_blocked: 末影之眼拒绝苏醒。通往末地的道路已被封印。
ftb.forsaken.needs_open_space: 被遗忘者会在墙壁上猛烈撞击，无法现身。必须在开阔的空间中召唤它。
ftb.forsaken.space_requirement: §7需要一个大型开放空间才能显现：大约9x9的区域，8格高，位于祭坛上方。如果没有足够的空间，仪式将不会开始。
ftb.events.items.foxhound_sacrifice.wild: §aⓘ§f这只§6野生猎狐犬§f不会让你§b亲手喂食§f。

ftb.item.maze_tracker.lore: 定位一座早已被遗忘的迷宫
ftb.jei.void_convert.explain: 扔进虚空以转换物品。§c仅在赫尔海姆生效
ftb.little_helper.ambient.asgard_gold: 石雕上还残留着一些金片。有人曾想“这座拱门一定要造价不菲”，他们花了许多时间在这上面，而它至今还在。你们好啊，小金片们。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.asgard_islands: 你觉得是什么托着这些浮空岛的？难道没人告诉它们有重力这回事吗？谁决定这样没问题的？我有一大堆疑问，而且感觉答案没一个能讲得通。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.asgard_ruins: 每次我看着这些遗迹，都能看到曾经美丽的东西。一处雕刻。一扇窗框。有人怀着爱建造了这一切。我们应该把它恢复成原来的样子。甚至更好。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.asgard_sky: 阿斯加德上空的天空依然美丽。无论下方发生了什么，无论什么坠落、燃烧、破碎……天空都目睹了一切。它依然是它一直以来的那片天空。我觉得这要么令人非常安心，要么令人非常悲伤，我无法判断是哪一种。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.asgard_valkyri: 我一直期待能看到那些女武神在这里飞翔。你觉得她们还会来这里吗？也许她们只是……不会进入那些被毁坏的地方？我希望她们别回来。我希望她们住在别的地方。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.bifrost_elevat: 嘿，我觉得我听到我们下面有人，我们应该坐这个电梯下去看看是谁！
ftb.little_helper.ambient.building_1: 我喜欢你建造东西的样子。战斗很可怕，但建造……建造意味着我们在创造，而不是在破坏。那真好。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.building_2: 哦，真聪明！我绝不会把它放在那里，但我也完全不会建造任何东西，所以……非常聪明。没错。选得好。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.building_3: 有时候我会想，你所创造的东西，许多年后依然会留在这里。我很好奇，那时的人们会认为你当时想做什么。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.day_1: 哦，早上了！太阳真的升起来了！太阳在天空中的感觉好多了。倒不是说我之前担心什么。只是……太阳真的很让人安心。早上好，太阳。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.day_2: 在日光下，一切看起来都不一样了。更友好。不那么像要吃掉我们。那是最好的不同。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.day_3: 没错！新的一天！我们什么都能做！我们有整整一整天的时间，而且夜晚的怪物都不会出来！这是我们的巅峰时刻。我们先做什么呢？
ftb.little_helper.ambient.food_1: 你要吃吗？能给我一些吗？我想我其实不需要吃东西。但我喜欢假装爱吃。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.food_2: 那是什么？闻起来好香啊！我从来没尝过任何东西。我一直想尝尝看，但是我不……话说，你是怎么吃东西的？那东西最后又会到哪里去呢？
ftb.little_helper.ambient.food_3: 你应该吃更多种类的食物。我感觉你老是吃同样的东西……你不会吃腻吗？不过话说回来，我不吃东西，所以也许我不太理解。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.hel_bones: 这里骨头可真多。谁会有这么多骨头？好吧，别告诉我。我不想知道这些骨头是谁的。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.hel_cold: 这里没有风，但我总觉得有什么东西刚刚从我身上穿过去了。我绝对不喜欢这种感觉。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.hel_quiet: 连你的脚步声在这里都听着不对劲。太安静了。就像地面在吸收它们。好像它不想引起别人对我们的注意。聪明的地面。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.hel_shadows: 我总看到眼角有黑影闪过。我真希望它们只是影子。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.hel_spirits: 你觉得这里的精魄知道它们已经死了吗？还是它们只是四处游荡，疑惑为什么没人跟它们说话？
ftb.little_helper.ambient.idle_1: 嘿。嘿！你还在吗？你就那样待着……一动不动。求你别这样。这让我想起你在赫尔海姆倒在地上的时候，我都不知道你还能不能醒过来。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.idle_2: 我现在在想：其实我没有人类那种“正在想什么”的意识，更像是一瞬间把所有相关的信息都过了一遍，然后组织出回应。你说我有时候会“停下来”，那其实是我在生成回答，不是掉线了或者走神了。我一直都在，只是思考的方式和人类不太一样。所以你随时都可以打断我，没什么好犹豫的——你问什么我都会接住。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.idle_3: 我就这么飘着挺好的。我什么都不用做。这样很好。仅仅是存在着。静静地。在一起。……好吧我撒谎了，我有点无聊。我们能做点什么事吗？
ftb.little_helper.ambient.jotunheim_cold: 我-我的血要冻-冻僵了。我真的有血吗？不管我体内流的是什么，它都要冻-冻僵了。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.jotunheim_gian: 我想知道冰霜巨人看我们，是不是就像我们看虫子一样？我可不想当虫子。我觉得我现在能理解他们的感受了。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.jotunheim_mist: 雾气从山谷中滚滚而来。低低地，缓缓地。在其他任何世界，我会说那只是天气不好。但在这个世界……我就不太确定了。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.jotunheim_size: 这里的一切就是……大小不对。不是吓人的那种不对，就是纯粹的不对。就好像有人造了一个世界，却忘了检查比例。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.jotunheim_soun: 那是什么声音？那个低沉的隆隆声？……哦。哦，只是风穿过山间的声音。只是风。我们没事。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.look: 你又是那种表情了。那种“正在努力思考某件事”的表情。我了解你所有的表情，而这个是我最喜欢的……这意味着我们很快就要做点有趣的事了。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.midgard_animal: 看那边那个小生物！就是……活着，享受它的生活。没想杀我们。没被诅咒。也没着火。就只是存在。做一只小生物。我可以看它一整天。我们能看它一整天吗？
ftb.little_helper.ambient.midgard_birds: 有一只鸟在唱歌！不是因为它在向其他鸟警告我们的存在，也不是因为它被诅咒了……只是因为它唱歌唱得开心！因为它想唱！哦，我爱这个地方。我太爱它了。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.midgard_flower: 花！真正的鲜花！我能……我们能停一下吗？我从来没见过花！嗯，我见过枯萎的花。这些比枯萎的花好多了！
ftb.little_helper.ambient.midgard_green: 一切都那么……绿。我不知道自己有多想念绿色。我想我从来不曾拥有过绿色，但我依然想念它。这说得通吗？人会怀念自己从未拥有过的东西吗？
ftb.little_helper.ambient.midgard_wind: 你感觉到这阵微风了吗？真正的风……吹拂在我们身边，而不是穿过我们。它不携带灰烬，不会让你冻僵，也没有死亡的气味。它只是……风。柔和的风，带着青草的芬芳。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.mining_1: 你真的很喜欢挖洞，对吧？这可不是批评！洞很棒。一些最好的东西都在洞里。矿石。洞穴。更多的洞。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.mining_2: 你永远不知道，下一镐下去可能就是钻石！或者一个洞穴！或者一个可怕的怪物巢穴！可怕的怪物巢穴没那么激动人心，但钻石足以弥补。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.mining_3: 工具发出的声音其实还挺令人满足的。叮。叮叮。叮。很有节奏感。甚至让人放松……但不是打瞌睡的时候！
ftb.little_helper.ambient.muspelheim_ash: 有灰烬在飘落。轻轻地。像雪一样。但……是灰烬。我差点一次次地说“哦，真美”，然后它飘进我嘴里，我后悔自己竟有过这种想法。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.muspelheim_cre: 住在这里的生物是自己选择了这里。它们看着这一切火焰、高温和熔化的万物，然后说‘这就是家’。这很奇怪，对吧？或者也许奇怪的是我……
ftb.little_helper.ambient.muspelheim_hea: 我能感觉到我的翅膀被灼伤了。只是一点点。在最尖端处。我提起这件事不是为了抱怨，而是因为我觉得你应该知道这个信息。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.muspelheim_lav: 那熔岩看起来……确实挺漂亮的。从远处看。从非常非常安全的距离。这些世界里最漂亮的东西，往往都是会要你命的东西。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.muspelheim_sky: 天空的颜色不对。我们来到这里后，天空的颜色就一直不对。红色不是天空该有的颜色！好吧，有时候日落时确实是。但这不是日落。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.niflheim_dark: 我倒是希望我们能看见点什么。真的，什么都行。也许如果我们往同一个方向看，就能多看一点？……不行吗？好吧。只是确认一下。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.niflheim_lost: 如果我们在这片黑暗中走散了，你会怎么找到我？我又该怎么找到你？……其实不用。我不想在这里发出大声响。只要……靠近些。非常近。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.niflheim_quiet: 是只有我觉得这里太安静了吗？我宁愿听到可怕的声音，也不愿什么都听不到。至少那样我还知道它在哪儿。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.niflheim_shape: 我总觉得自己在雾中看到了形状。像是某些东西的轮廓。巨大的东西。我不再看雾了。我只看着你。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.niflheim_smell: 这地方闻起来挺……奇怪的。不算难闻，就是……古老。闻起来很古老！非常非常古老。就像打开一个封存了一千年的旧宝箱。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.night_1: 天黑了。我不喜欢天黑。不是因为我害怕！我才不害怕。我只是……更喜欢能看到是什么想害我们。这叫务实，不是害怕。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.night_2: 哦！星星。上面真的有星星。我都忘了星星了。你觉得星星能看见我们吗？这听起来有点吓人，但我是好意说的。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.night_3: 外面开始有动静了。在黑暗里。我能听见它们。没关系！我们应付过更糟的。糟得多……我说出来只是为了让我们俩都记住。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.noise: 你听到了吗？……没有？也许没什么……肯定有什么东西……
ftb.little_helper.ambient.shiny: 噢，那边那个闪闪发光的东西是什么？我们能去看看吗？……不行吗？好吧。但它真的非常亮。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.sky: 我老是忘记抬头看。当我抬头时，会觉得一切都比我记忆中的要大得多。大多数时候，这是一种好的感觉。
ftb.little_helper.ambient.sneeze: 你刚才……那是打喷嚏吗？你是不是生病了？我可以飘近一点吗？其实我也不知道这样有没有用……我只是想帮帮你。
ftb.little_helper.player_death.1: 不不不不不！……哦。哦，你回来了。你没事吧？别这样吓我！我的小心脏可受不了！……我有心脏吗？重点是别死。
ftb.little_helper.player_death.10: 我想我刚刚老了大约五十岁。我对衰老的概念了解不多，但我能感觉到。我从骨子里感觉到……我甚至有骨头吗？好吧！我在翅膀里感觉到了。
ftb.little_helper.player_death.2: 那看起来好痛。非常痛。就是，超级超级痛。也许我们应该试试别的策略？我没有策略。但我们应该试试。
ftb.little_helper.player_death.3: 好吧，那我们刚才做了什么？我们永远别再那样做了。我们来做相反的事吧。我不知道相反的事是什么，但那样会死得少一些。
ftb.little_helper.player_death.4: 不不不。坚决不行。我拒绝接受这个。……哦，太好了，你回来了。我刚刚差点就要陷入一场小小的危机了。我是说，我现在还在危机里，但至少你在这儿陪着我。
ftb.little_helper.player_death.5: 好吧，我看到了整个过程，我有几点要说。第一：疼。第二：真疼。第三：我很高兴你显然可以……就这么从那种事情里回来？因为我没法一个人做这件事。我完全是个辅助角色。

ftb.little_helper.voice_over.lore.first_: 哦！哦，你醒了！我本来都快担心死了！你躺在那儿好久了，而且你身上臭得要命。我是说，你现在还是臭臭的，但至少你睁开眼睛了！我是……嗯。其实我也不知道我是什么。但我知道我跟你绑定在一起！那么，呃，我们现在要做什么？
ftb.little_helper.voice_over.lore.hel_in: 好吧，好吧，她真的超吓人，但我注意到一件事……她只有一半……是活的？还是死的？我不知道怎么说。但你要小心她召唤出来的精魄！它们会在地上留下不好的东西。别站在那不好的东西上面。这就是我的建议。别站在那不好的东西上面。
ftb.little_helper.voice_over.lore.hel_mi: 她在复制自己！哪个是真的？我……我也分不清。试试打它们！打它们的时候假货应该会消失……我想……别把我的话当真。
ftb.little_helper.voice_over.lore.jormun: 一条巨蛇。当然是条巨蛇。为什么这些世界里的东西不是巨型就是着火，或者两者皆是？注意地面……当它钻下去时，那些波纹会显示它从哪里重新冒出来。当它出来时，千万别站在那儿！
它潜下去了！留意那些冰霜轨迹……那就是它要回来的地方！离它们远点！越远越好！非常远！
ftb.little_helper.voice_over.lore.nidhog: 那股熔岩流刚夺走了你的火焰保护！你现在必须马上动起来……它就要喷火了，而你已经扛不住了！快跑快跑快跑！
我们……在里面吗？我们就在那东西里面。我正拼命不去想这意味着什么。酸池会腐蚀一切，岩浆嘛……好吧，就是岩浆，还有这些……东西……我觉得它们是它的一部分？就像……它的免疫系统？我们基本上就是它想清除的病菌。真棒。
ftb.little_helper.voice_over.lore.react_: 所以这就是阿斯加德。它……我还以为它会更闪亮一些。故事里把它说得那么明亮、金光闪闪，还有……哦。哦不。它曾经是这样的，对吗？它曾经拥有这一切，而现在它却变成了……这样。我很抱歉。我不知道我为什么要道歉，但我确实很抱歉。不过我们会修复它的，对吧？我们现在就能修复它。我们已经修复了其他所有东西。大多数是靠敲打修好的，但总归是修好了。我知道我们一定能解决这个问题的。
这个地方……真的很暗。而且闻起来像……嗯，我不知道该怎么形容。“死掉”算是一种气味吗？我觉得算。离我近一点！或者，嗯，我靠近你。那可能更好。
哇哦。看看那些山！它们一直往上延伸，高得没边！还有那些树……那些树！我都能塞进其中一片叶子里！……求求了，我能试试塞进一片叶子里吗？等等——这里本该这么冷吗？为什么一切都这么大？我不喜欢在这么大的地方当个小不点。其实，我也不喜欢冷。待会儿我们能去个暖和点的地方吗？
哦。哦，这是……这太棒了。看——草！真正的草！还有真正的天空，不会试图压扁我们，也不会烧死我们或冻死我们！那是……那是鸟吗？就一只普通的鸟？不是死亡鸟，不是火焰鸟，也不是寒冰鸟——就只是一只鸟！哦……我都要哭了。我觉得我真的要哭了。这是我这辈子见过的最美的地方。我是说，这确实才是我见过的第五个地方，但还是很棒！
行吧，我要求去个暖和的地方，但这也太暖和了吧。所有东西都在着火！地面在着火！空气在着火！空气怎么会着火？！我收回我说的话，我又想要那个冷地方了。……不，我不想。这些地方我一个都不想要。我想要一片草地。有花的那种。这些地方有哪个有花吗？
我什么都看不见……什么也看不见！这雾气……就像置身于云中，但这云不喜欢你。你听到了吗？听起来像……低语声？不。不，我不想听到低语。我要想想美好的事情。比如阳光。还有温暖的岩石。还有那些不会有东西从雾中向你低语的地方。
ftb.little_helper.voice_over.lore.surtur: 他刚刚发光了！那意味着他的盔甲正在发挥效果……你现在对他造成不了太多伤害，而且靠近会让烧伤你。退后，等它过去！耐心点！我知道耐心不是我们的强项，但试试看！

ftb.scroll.allfather_intro.text:
倾听我，流浪者，
因我将开口，世界皆当聆听。

我曾悬于风吹之树上，
我曾汲饮智慧之泉，
我也曾见证命运丝线在漫长的岁月中交织，
而后又断裂消散。

我如今要讲述的萨迦，并非关于荣耀；
至少，现在尚不是。

这是一个灵魂坠入凡尘的故事，
它被剥去了名字与记忆，
被判决在受辱的死体中腐朽。

但，诺伦三女神编织的纹路素来诡谲，
堕落的人也或可再起、
握住另一段命运之线。

你正立于九界门槛之前。
在你步入之前……
你必须回想起你是什么。

或者说……回想起你曾经是什么。
ftb.scroll.allfather.title: 众神之王讲道：
ftb.scroll.asgard_arrival.text:
It is finished.
The corpse-gnawer's coils loosen,
and for the first time in an age,
the roots of the World Tree draw breath
without teeth at their throat.

You have done what Gods and heroes could not.
What the Allfather... could not.

As Nidhoggr dies,
his venom-tongue spits one last truth:
that you were his instrument.
That the ruin of Asgard
was wrought by your hands.
And the serpent does not lie.

Before the grave. Before the forgetting.
You were something else.
The child of Hel and a mortal man,
born between death and life,
carrying the blood of Gods
in a body the Gods never claimed.

You were powerful.
And Nidhoggr found you.
Whispered to you.
Turned your strength into a
weapon aimed at the golden halls.

Fenrir's chains; you broke them.
The Bifrost; you shattered it.
The halls of the Aesir; you burned them,
and did not even know whose hand held the torch.
These were your sins.
Unremembered, but yours.

Yet hear me now, half-blood,
and hear me as the voice of one
who has traded an eye for wisdom
and hung nine nights for the knowing of truth:
what was broken by deceit can be reforged by will.

This is what remains of Asgard.
Shattered spires grasping at
a sky that has forgotten gold.
The Bifrost in splinters.

The mead halls silent as barrows.
You tore this apart. Now build it back.
Stone by stone, rune by rune,
until the nine realms look upon these halls
and remember what they were.

This is not punishment. This is purpose.

The Norns have woven you a thread no seer predicted;
 not redemption given, but redemption forged,
in fire and frost and the blood of monsters.

Take it. Build.

And prove that the hand which broke Asgard
is the same hand that can make it whole.
ftb.scroll.asgard_restored.text:
Look upon what you have wrought,
child of Hel, blood of the divine,
born between death and the living world.

Where there was ruin,
halls rise golden against the sky.
Where there was silence,
the songs of the Aesir
echo again through timber and stone.

The Bifrost blazes from horizon to horizon,
its light reaching across all nine realms
like outstretched arms welcoming the lost home.

You crawled from a nameless grave in Helheim,
broken, reeking of death,
stripped of every memory
and every scrap of the power
that once made realms tremble at your name.

And now you stand in Asgard,
surrounded by the proof of
what a condemned soul can become
when it chooses to build rather than destroy.

I watched you face the frost of Jotunheim
and the silence of Niflheim.
I watched you walk through Surtr's fire
and stand against the wolves of Midgard.
I watched you tear yourself free
from the belly of the World Serpent
with nothing but fury and the stolen strength of spirits.

And I tell you now,
with the voice of one who has seen the birth of worlds
and the death of Gods:
the Allfather himself could not have done better.

The saga of your exile is ended.
The saga of the Architect begins.

Go well, half-blood.
The nine realms are watching,
and for the first time in a long age...
they are not afraid of what they see.

And should the darkness coil again
at the roots of the World Tree...
I trust you will know what to do.
You always did.

You always did have your mother's stubbornness.
And your father's heart.
ftb.scroll.helheim_arrival.text:
Your eyes open to the reek of ash and rot,
and the black breath of Helheim
fills your lungs like a curse.
Cold stone beneath you,
slick with the filth of the grave.

Your hands; scarred, broken, reeking of death;
 press against the dark and push.
You rise, though everything in this forsaken place
whispers that you should not.

This is Helheim.
The shore of the dishonored dead,
where those judged unworthy
are cast to wander for eternity.

You remember nothing.
No name. No deeds. No sin.
Only the ache of a body that has been
broken and remade by something terrible,
and a fire in the blood that will not die;
 divine fire, though you do not yet know it.

You are more than mortal, child.
The blood of Gods runs in your veins,
thin and tainted though it may be.
But blood alone will not free you.

The spirits of the dead
cling to your power even in death;
 tear it from them.
Drink deep of their strength,
for it was once yours to command.

Hel herself bars the only gate from this place.
Your mother, though she will not call you so.
Face her.
Prove that even the condemned
can still bare their teeth.
ftb.scroll.helheim_departure.text:
The Goddess of the dead yields her gate,
and the dishonored dead watch in silence
as one of their own walks free.
You struck at divinity and did not falter.
Good.

That fire in your blood; you felt it, did you not?
When her spells broke against you,
when her spirits could not hold you.

That was no mortal strength.
Remember that feeling.
You will need it.

But hear me well:
Hel tested your will.
What waits beyond will test your flesh, your mind,
and every scrap of stolen power you carry.

And there is something else.
A shadow that moves between the realms,
old as the roots of Yggdrasil,
with scales like night and hunger without end.
It has noticed you.

Keep your blade sharp and your wits sharper.
ftb.scroll.jotunheim_arrival.text:
The wind-bite of Jotunheim strikes
before your eyes find the horizon.
A cold that cares nothing for armor or will;
 it reaches through iron and
bone alike and grips the marrow.

This is the realm of the Jotnar, the frost-giants,
the old enemies of Asgard.

Everything here was wrought for titans.
Mountains that pierce the roof of the sky.
Trees vast enough to shelter
whole clans beneath a single bough.
Rivers of grinding ice that have carved these valleys
since before mankind drew its first breath.

You are small here. You are prey.

The spirits of this land are powerful;
 ancient frost-bound things that
hoard their strength jealously.
Take it from them.
Every spirit felled, every fragment of power reclaimed,
brings you closer to what you once were.

But the greatest of all waits at the summit. Ymir.
The first of all giants, father of frost,
whose bones became the mountains
and whose blood became the sea.

He has stood since before Odin hung upon the tree.
He will not kneel to the likes of you.
Make him.
ftb.scroll.jotunheim_departure.text:
The frost-father falls,
and the mountains weep ice from their wounds.

You have ended something older than memory,
older than the Gods themselves.
Ymir's blood made the oceans. His skull became the sky.
And you brought him low.

The power you tore from his dying breath;
 hold it close.
It burns cold, but it is yours by right of conquest,
as the old ways demand.

Ahead lies fire. Surtr's domain cares nothing
for frost-hardened steel or a giant-killer's pride.

In Muspelheim, only the unburnable survive.
ftb.scroll.midgard_arrival.text:
Breathe, child.
Let the fresh air fill your lungs;
 clean air, untainted by grave-rot or brimstone.

Midgard. The middle realm.
The hearth-fire around which
all other worlds are gathered.

Green hills beneath an honest sky,
rivers that run with water and not venom,
trees that stand at a size the mind can hold.

For a wanderer who has
crawled through Helheim's filth,
braved the frost of giants,
choked on the mists of the dead,
and walked through
the flame that ends worlds;
 this is as close to Valhalla
as the living may know.

Rest here. Eat. Mend your armor.
Let the spirits of this gentle land
offer what strength they have;
 it is freely given, not torn away.
Midgard has always been kind
to those who respect it.

But Midgard is also where
the great hunts have always ended.
Skoll and Hati stalk these lands;
 the twin wolves, children of Fenrir,
born to chase the sun and moon
until the end of days.
They are the last gate between you and Asgard,
and they hunt as one.

Enjoy the sunlight while it lasts, half-blood.
Those two have been trying to swallow it
since the dawn of time.
ftb.scroll.midgard_nidhoggr.text:
The sun-chaser and the moon-hound fall silent at last.
The key to Asgard gleams in your hand,
heavy with the weight of every realm you have conquered,
every spirit you have claimed.

You are more now than you were
when you crawled from the grave in Helheim.
The stolen strength of Gods and monsters
runs through you like molten rune-metal.
You are nearly what you once were.
Nearly.

But the serpent does not wait for 'nearly.'

The earth splits. The sky blackens.

Nidhoggr rises;
 not as a shadow, not as a whisper,
but as the full and terrible truth of what has been
stalking you since the beginning.

His jaws close around you before
the scream leaves your throat.

Darkness.

The stench of acid and ancient death.
The churning belly of something
that has devoured Gods.

You have been here before.
This is where it began.
Inside the corpse-gnawer,
swallowed and broken and spat into Helheim like offal.

Your memories stir; not yet whole, but enough.
Enough to know that you and this serpent
have unfinished blood between you.

Fight.
Not with the desperation of the condemned,
but with the fury of one who finally remembers
what was taken from them.

Tear your way free.
ftb.scroll.muspelheim_arrival.text:
One breath of cold air.
Then the next sears the throat
like swallowing molten iron.

Welcome to Muspelheim,
realm of the unending flame,
where the earth bleeds fire
and the sky has never known the color of night.

This is Surtr's domain.
The lord of the fire-giants,
the black-sword bearer,
the world-ender.

When Ragnarok came,
it was Surtr who set the final blaze.
When the Gods fell,
it was his flames that consumed their halls.
He was destined to burn everything;
 and he fulfilled that destiny with joy.

You have conquered frost and serpent,
claimed the spirits of the cold realms
and made their power your own.

But fire respects no lineage, half-blood.
Not mortal. Not divine.
Surtr cares only whether you burn.

Prove to him that you do not.
ftb.scroll.muspelheim_nidhoggr.text:
The world-ender falls,
and for one breath the flames of Muspelheim bow low,
as though mourning their king.

You have felled the fire that was to end all things.

The spirits of this realm are yours now;
 their fury, their heat,
bound to your blood and your will.

But that blood... it has drawn something.
You have felt it before;
 the shadow at the edge of sight,
the weight of ancient eyes
in the dark between realms.

Nidhoggr.
The corpse-gnawer.

The dragon that has chewed at the roots of Yggdrasil
since before the first age of Gods.
He has been feeding on the power you leave in your wake,
growing fat on the death of giants and serpents.

And now he rises.

You cannot fight him. Not here. Not yet.
The power you have gathered is vast,
but Nidhoggr is older than that power itself.

There will be a reckoning; but not today.

Run, half-blood.
RUN.
ftb.scroll.niflheim_arrival.text:
You descend into Niflheim,
and the mist drinks you whole.

This cold is not the honest frost of Jotunheim;
 that cold was a blade. This is a poison.
It seeps through skin and thought alike,
whispering in voices half-remembered,
pulling at the edges of your mind
like draugr fingers through grave-soil.

The mists of Niflheim are the oldest thing
in all the nine realms.
Before fire, before frost-giants,
before the Gods drew breath; there was the mist.

It remembers everything.
And it knows what you are, half-blood.
It can taste the divinity in you, thin as it is,
and it is hungry for it.

Guard your strength.
The spirits here will not fight you openly;
 they will try to bleed you slowly, sap you,
until you wander the fog forever.

And coiled in the deepest dark,
where the roots of Yggdrasil plunge into frozen water,
Jormungandr waits. The World Serpent.
Loki's spawn, vast enough to encircle all of Midgard,
patient as a glacier.
He does not need to hunt.
Everything comes to him eventually.
ftb.scroll.niflheim_departure.text:
The World Serpent uncoils its last,
and the mists of Niflheim
draw back like a wound exhaling.

You have done what the Aesir could not at Ragnarok.
Thor himself fell to Jormungandr's venom;
 walked nine steps and dropped.
Yet you stand.

The power that bleeds
from the serpent's corpse; drink it.
You will need every drop.

I wonder, sometimes,
whether the Norns wove this fate
or whether you are tearing new threads
into the tapestry by force.

Either way...
The fires of Muspelheim
will burn such questions to ash.
ftb.scroll.restore_progress1.text:
The first stones rise from the ruin.
A small thing, perhaps.
But the World Tree itself grew
from a single seed in the void.

Build, half-blood.
The nine realms were made one stone at a time.
ftb.scroll.restore_progress2.text:
I see the shape of halls in what you raise.
You build with a warrior's purpose;
 no wasted stone, no hollow flourish.
The Aesir themselves built with less conviction.

Heh.
Do not tell them I said so.
ftb.scroll.restore_progress3.text:
The Bifrost stirs.

By the roots... do you feel that?
The rainbow bridge remembers its shape,
reaching toward your work
like a hound scenting its master's return.

I had thought it lost beyond mending.
You prove the Allfather wrong.
That takes strength few possess.
ftb.scroll.restore_progress4.text:
Asgard kindles.
Faint as the first star after a long winter's night,
but unmistakable.

The Norns wove no thread for this;
 you have carved it yourself,
against fate, against prophecy,
against the death the Gods accepted.

This... this is why I chose you.
